title: Maritime Supply Chain Disruption Index (MSDI): code, validation data, and results
description:
Reproducible pipeline for an LLM-derived, human-validated Maritime Supply Chain Disruption Index (MSDI), used to forecast Shanghai Containerized Freight Index (SCFI) movements, with time-series causality, double/debiased machine learning, multiplicity, and sensitivity analyses.

Includes analysis code, configuration, LLM prompts, human validation annotations (400 articles, 50-article pilot, 300 event pairs), and selected result tables. The full news corpus, market price series, and intermediate data are not included; see README.md.
